messages:
Eve (partnerships): quick huddle 1: onboarding a new partner for AWS/GCP/Azure listings. we need a tight runbook for trial images, entitlement tokens, and the marketplace blurb.
Noah (product): trial = 14d, up to 8 seats, metered vCPU hours. include a visible badge: '14-day trial'.
Zara (legal): send me the exact blurb text and data residency promise. i'll add the opt-out telemetry and retention clause.
Diego (eng): artifacts: AWS AMI (signed), GCP image or tar importer, Azure VHD or ACR image. SBOM + scan report required.
Mina (cloud-ops): for AWS we need publisher account id + cross-account role ARN. GCP needs project id + service account email with compute.imageUser. Azure needs publisher tenant id + storage SAS or ACR push.
Liam (partner-success): partner wants one-click trial activation from the listing. can we pre-issue entitlements?
Mina (cloud-ops): yes, we can mint ephemeral entitlement tokens tied to a staging tenant; tokens TTL = 30 days.
Ruth (security): images must have no critical vulns and include SBOM. runtime hardening: non-root user, disable password auth, minimal surface.
Diego (eng): sample assume-role policy we'll accept (AWS):
```json
{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::PUBLISHER_ACCOUNT:role/MarketplacePublishRole"},"Action":"sts:AssumeRole"}]}
```
Diego (eng): manifest format suggestion: name, version, sku, trial_days, checksum, sbom_url. keep it simple.
Liam (partner-success): i'll ask partner to upload a gzipped bundle to our staging bucket and provide checksum + manifest.
Uploader-Bot: staging-creds issued -> https://ci.redwood/creds/pub-789 (expires 2026-04-02)
Eve (partnerships): immediate actions: 1) Diego + Mina: publish checklist & IAM snippets (EOD). 2) Zara + Noah: trial copy + billing SKU map (48h). 3) Liam: artifact link + manifest (EOD). 4) Ruth: security gate spec + SBOM headers (EOD).
Noah (product): i'll add a tiny QA harness to validate entitlement redemption and billing events. will include curl examples.
Diego (eng): i'll also include recommended instance sizes for perf notes and a smoke test script.
Ruth (security): will prepare attestation template for partner signatures (data processing + logging).
Mina (cloud-ops): publishing ETA once we have signed images + legal okay: AWS/GCP ~48h, Azure 3-5 days.
Liam (partner-success): partner replied: will upload tonight and share checksum.
Zara (legal): blocker: none if we get wording + attestation. add refund policy for early conversions.
Eve (partnerships): great. i'll collate into a one-pager runbook and share PR link here when ready. tag me for any blockers. :sparkles:
